title: Rambo PPL
author: Ortticus
desc: Unleash your inner warrior with the Rambo PPL Program, a hardcore 6-day Push-Pull-Legs system built for lifters who refuse to settle for average. Designed around science-based hypertrophy principles, progressive overload, and high-performance training, Rambo PPL targets every major muscle group with an emphasis on broad shoulders, a thick V-taper back, a powerful upper chest, massive arms, and tree-trunk legs. Each workout combines heavy compound lifts, strategic accessory work, and optimal training volume to maximize muscle growth, strength, and recovery. If you’re ready to train with intensity, push past your limits, and build a physique that commands respect, Rambo PPL is your mission.
